gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Comfortaa draws every letter with a neon-tube consistency, its c a wide-open ring and its spacing stretched loose. Noto Sans Hatran adds a friendly funnel-shaped e.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Comfortaa's c is a wide-open ring, and its strokes keep one steady line from corner to curve. Big and short is where it earns its place.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Noto Sans Javanese reads clean and unfussy, its curves left open to the outside. Comfortaa sits above it like a plotter pen's single line, round and friendly, so the two feel like neighbors of different temperaments.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Noto Sans Kawi has a c with jaws open like pliers. Over a longer passage it feels clean and neutral, a quiet counterpart to the flat, friendly Comfortaa above.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Comfortaa looks drawn by a fixed-width nib, with a c like a wide-open ring and loosely stretched spacing. And Noto Sans Linear A answers with a gaping c of its own, which gives the pair a shared openness.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B moves smoothly around every bend. Shrink Comfortaa down and its pointed-brush-free, single-weight line loses its neon-tube charm, so give it room.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Comfortaa's strokes are plain as stitched thread outlines. Noto Sans Manichaean brings crossbars with open mouths below, and the two read as friendly and modern together, one rounder and one crisper.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Friendly describes Comfortaa, a geometric display face drawn with one pen tip and a ring-like c. Noto Sans Mongolian follows with flared terminals, and the pair's strongest quality is how smoothly round meets modern.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Round, geometric and bright, Comfortaa looks drawn with steady pen pressure from first letter to last. Noto Sans New Tai Lue keeps its round letters cupped rather than clenched, so a long passage goes down easily.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-nko: Comfortaa builds every letter from one stroke width, with a c that looks like a wide-open ring. And Noto Sans NKo carries that openness into body text, with c openings you can see through.
